notes.title: Demo Coming Soon
notes.content:
The first build of Draco's Misfortune's demo will be playable in the next couple of weeks (November). I'm taking this as an opportunity beta test it seen as you will be the first people playing the game.

There will probably be a few bugs and I'm going to take this as an opportunity (but more of an opportunity I took in the first paragraph) to update and fix these.
